premises.text: Attention spans have decreased significantly among younger generations
premises.evidence_span: Our attention spans. My generation has half the attention span that the generation before me did.

premises.text: Students struggle to engage with traditional learning materials
premises.evidence_span: How do you convince a generation that spends eight hours a day on Snapchat and TikTok to spend two hours a day on a textbook

premises.text: Generative AI can help students learn faster and help teachers teach faster
premises.evidence_span: We're building generative AI to help students learn faster and help teachers teach faster.

premises.text: The Kato product allows students to create flashcards quickly using OCR technology
premises.evidence_span: Our initial product, Kato, allows students to create flashcards with just a picture of their textbooks.

premises.text: Milo acts as a virtual learning assistant that provides instant Q&A generation
premises.evidence_span: Milo is a virtual learning assistant that acts as a tutor in your pocket.

premises.text: The AI models specialize in language and can process information efficiently
premises.evidence_span: we specialize in language. We use semantic understanding to silo language models and process information in a way that very few models do today.

premises.text: The Q&A generation algorithm is significantly faster than industry benchmarks
premises.evidence_span: our Q&A generation algorithm takes 200 milliseconds to create questions and answers, whereas the next industry benchmark is 1,200 milliseconds.

premises.text: The founders have personal experience as users of their product
premises.evidence_span: we are our own user. Me and my co-founders are 19 years old and dropped out of university to focus on what's important.

premises.text: The product can be adapted for workplace training and upskilling
premises.evidence_span: we now use our AI models beyond just students and we're able to service workplace and training.

value.text: Learning becomes more engaging and efficient for students and employees
value.evidence_span: building an information pipeline that not just we could use, but our peers could use.
